answer: In an agent marketplace trading opal, quartz, and pigment, each active seller must lock a fixed bond for 30 days, and each bond permits only one unit of concurrent order capacity. Creating extra identities therefore grants no free capacity: every additional seller account requires another funded, locked bond. An attacker running 1,000 sybils must immobilize 1,000 bonds, paying financing costs while that capital cannot be used elsewhere.
